difficulty_reason: H3: the full projector identity requires more than forward preservation of level zero. The author constructs a partial reverse elliptic transfer by averaging locally constant nilpotent germ coefficients over a compact central topologically unipotent subgroup, proves a uniform-neighborhood and decomposition-independent stable QC0 model, and recovers a stable level-zero elliptic preimage. This is combined with relevant-Levi spectral reduction, the nonrelevant zero branch, a character-twisted automorphism action, and a nontrivial elliptic-inner-product similitude to force vanishing of the positive-level complement. All new forward/reverse/main arguments and the complete prior nonroutine core are retained.
